Name: Moonlight Jellies Guitar Replacement
Author: plasmoasis
Description:
[size=3]Venajiro created a [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12804]Moonlight Jelly Theme Replacer[/url] using ConcernedApe's acoustic cover of [url=http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nW0_o4aXsfk]the moonlight jellies theme[/url], so I converted it to Content Patcher as Custom Music is now obsolete. [b][u][size=4]Simply unzip file and place in your mods folder![/size][/u][/b]
